    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_57/training_14.csv"
]

# Read all source tables into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    # Ensure the column is integer type as per target schema
    df['last_credit_pull_d'] = df['last_credit_pull_d'].astype(int)
    dfs.append(df)

# UNION operation: concatenate all DataFrames vertically
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure the target schema column is integer type
target_df['last_credit_pull_d'] = target_df['last_credit_pull_d'].astype(int)

# Write the result to the target CSV file
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_57/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
